meta.shelfRule: One PC (OPT/OPTN, type opt) per shelf on the left; one Lab Manager rack item on the right (type equip-switch = switch under test, equip-ups, equip-other …). U01 = top shelf. When connected, live rack items replace JSON equipment with the same name.
